verdict.rationale: Cloudflare provides a documented Registrar API for searching, checking, registering, and managing domains (docs-10), backed by an OpenAPI spec (probe-3), covering most core dashboard functions like renewal, WHOIS editing, and domain locking. However, some UI-configurable options (e.g., DNSSEC one-click activation, auto-renew toggles) are not explicitly confirmed as API-exposed in the evidence, and there's no independent hands-on confirmation of full UI/API parity. Missing for 10: explicit API endpoint confirmation for DNSSEC activation and auto-renew toggling, independent/community verification that all UI actions are API-reachable.
